rawConfiguration.text:
## Live Sessions & Query Samples
Real-time snapshot from db.server.query_sample, refreshed on the metrics collection_interval.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Log SELECT latest(`mysql.threads.thread_id`) AS 'Thread', latest(`mysql.session.id`) AS 'Session', latest(`user.name`) AS 'DB user', latest(`db.namespace`) AS 'Database', latest(`db.query.text`) AS 'Query', latest(`mysql.threads.processlist_state`) AS 'State', latest(`mysql.events_statements_current.timer_wait`) AS 'Elapsed (s)' WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.query_sample' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' FACET `mysql.event_id`, `mysql.instance.endpoint` LIMIT 100

FROM Log SELECT uniqueCount(tuple(`mysql.threads.thread_id`, `mysql.session.id`)) WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.query_sample' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' FACET `mysql.session.status`, `mysql.instance.endpoint`

FROM Log SELECT uniqueCount(tuple(`mysql.threads.thread_id`, `mysql.session.id`)) WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.query_sample' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' FACET `mysql.session.status`, `mysql.instance.endpoint` TIMESERIES

FROM Log SELECT uniqueCount(tuple(`mysql.threads.thread_id`, `mysql.session.id`)) AS 'Sessions' WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.query_sample' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' FACET `mysql.session.client_name`, `client.address`, `mysql.instance.endpoint` LIMIT 50

FROM Log SELECT latest(`db.query.text`) AS 'Query', latest(`db.query.comment_tags.nr_service_guid`) AS 'APM service GUID' WHERE `event.name` = 'db.server.query_sample' AND `db.system.name` = 'mysql' AND `db.query.comment_tags.nr_service_guid` IS NOT NULL AND `db.query.comment_tags.nr_service_guid` != '' FACET `mysql.event_id`, `mysql.instance.endpoint` LIMIT 50
